From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-12 09:07 -0700
Subject: Next steps to complete supplier setup — Kulinaris Foods

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for signing the partner agreement last week — excited to get Kulinaris set up so we can start routing procurement and POs. Finance needs a couple of items from your side to complete vendor onboarding in our systems: 

- Completed Vendor Intake Form (attached)
- Completed and signed W-9 (if US entity) or W-8BEN-E (if non-US entity) — please send the appropriate form signed
- VAT registration certificate (if registered in the UK/EU) or VAT number
- Legal entity name as it appears on tax docs and the remit-to billing address
- Primary billing email for receiving POs and invoices

Can you please return the intake form and either the W-8BEN-E plus VAT certificate, or W-9, by end of day Friday? Once finance has these, they’ll create the supplier record and issue your first PO.

I’ve cc’d Marissa (Finance) and Laura (Legal) for visibility — Marissa: once we have the docs, can you confirm whether Redwood needs any additional tax substantiation for EU vendors?

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Strategic GTM
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the note — Kulinaris is based in the UK, so please find attached our signed W-8BEN-E along with our VAT registration certificate.

Quick answers:
- Legal name on tax docs: Kulinaris Foods Ltd.
- Billing email: invoices@kulinarisfoods.co.uk
- We can accept PO net 30.

I attached the documents as PDFs. Let me know if anything is missing — happy to re-sign if you need a different format.

Best,
Sofia

Attachments: W-8BEN-E_Kulinaris_signed.pdf, VAT_Certificate_Kulinaris.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-08-12 13:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps to complete supplier setup — Kulinaris Foods

Hi Sofia,

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of quick follow-ups from Finance to complete the record in Coupa: 

1) Can you confirm the "Chapter 3" status on page 4 of the W-8BEN-E (i.e., whether Kulinaris is claiming treaty benefits or acting as a corporation)? We need the checkboxes to be explicit for our tax team.
2) Please confirm the payee TIN/EORI if you have one — we store the EORI for EU vendors for reporting purposes (you can redact bank/account numbers).
3) We need a signed Supplier Terms acknowledgement (I attached our standard Supplier_Terms_Redwood.pdf); please sign and return so we can proceed with the PO workflow.

Once we receive the completed Supplier Terms and the short clarifications above, I’ll create the supplier in our ERP and route the first PO. Expected lead time after docs: 2–3 business days.

Thanks —
Marissa
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
